My four‑legged family has been cared for by Beechwood Vets for over three years, and their service has been outstanding. Catarina, Blanca and James are exceptional veterinarians with a truly compassionate approach. Both Sandy (12) and Amy (13) have undergone surgery here, and thanks to the team, everything — from the operations to the recovery — went perfectly.

They’re on health plans, so their treatments are regularly reviewed, and I always receive thoughtful, reliable advice. Yesterday James handled their annual vaccinations, carefully checking their histories and adjusting Sandy’s treatment plan. The pets didn’t even notice the injections.

The receptionists are equally wonderful — warm, efficient and always ready with a kind word or a gentle stroke for the animals. Communication is fast, and reminders for appointments and parasite treatments are always on time.

I have a dog and a cat registered in this clinic. Sandy, the dog, has some particular skin conditions that make her life and ours very difficult. I can’t be more grateful to Caterina, Sandy and Amy’s vet who has made a wonderful change in our life’s by looking after Sandy’s condition. Following her advises Sandy is having a better quality life. Caterina is a very knowledgeable professional who doesn’t rumble around the dog trying to sale something. She identifies the health problems by observing and exploring the animal and she goes straight to the point and provides the options available. She’s very considerate when understanding the difficulties facing expensive treatments and if there are alternatives she won’t hesitate to mention them, however always prioritising the best for the animal health. Her conexión with the animal is awesome. She has a confident approach and positive energy with them. Fantastic vet. I highly recommend Caterina.
